title: Fall Gnome
text: Fall Gnome. This fall gnome is pretty cute. He's a little larger than I expected and will make a good addition to my fall theme decor. The pumpkin that he sits on is weighted so he won't tip over too easily. The quality is decent. I didn't notice any problems with his construction.

product_metadata.title: SDKBVOC Fall Gnome with Plaid Buffalo Check Pumpkin Harvest Nisse Nordic Tomte with Sunflower Hat Autumn Thanksgiving Day Home Party Decorations
features: Add a touch of joy to your home in this fall season with this whimsical pumpkin today! Grab attention in any space with this fall gnome. Whether alone or with other accents, it is sure to inspire happiness!

This SDKBVOC 14" Fall season pumpkin gnome is a perfect decoration to accompany you through this season! It features a gnome sits on it, maple leaves in bright fall colors under the gnome. The gnome wears a knitted hat with sunflowers. Scarecrow and faded boots details add natural fall rustic appeal. The plaid pumpkin is a plush figure made of soft fabric. Weighted bottoms for self-standing.

This farmhouse tabletop feature an adorable gnome and fake pumpkin as the main elements. This gnome characters will add a taste of whimsy to your Halloween decorating theme. Long fluffy gray beards flow from beneath tall pointed hats that hide their eyes. Make your home spooky but also cute with this gnome!
Decorate for autumn with this pumpkin gnome that keep your home festive and fun. Package includes: 1 x Fall pumpkin gnome, which measures approx. 14*7.5 inch in size.
Decked out in classic fall colors, this assortment of this plush gnome will spruce up mantels, tables, and more throughout the spooky season. These gnomes feature dimensional accents and fun details.
